critical_clause_threshold.statement: For r=6, 1+636+Wmax_6(636)=3361<3364, hence any cap violation requires at least 637 distinct raw clauses.

finite_sublemma.name: THREE_COORDINATE_TWO_MASK_SEPARATION
finite_sublemma.statement: For distinct masks b1,b2 in {-1,0,+1}^3, at most eight nonzero ternary tails q are simultaneously compatible with both masks and satisfy union(b1,q) != union(b2,q).
proof: Classify each coordinate of (b1,b2) as Z=(0,0), S=(s,s), H=(0,s) or (s,0), or O=(+,-)/(-,+). Because b1!=b2, H+O>=1.

If O>=1, every compatible q separates the two unions. The O coordinate is forced to zero. The remaining two coordinates provide at most 3^2 compatible assignments; deleting the all-zero q leaves at most 8.

If O=0, separation requires at least one H coordinate to choose q=0 rather than the shared nonzero symbol. With z+s+h=3 and h>=1, the number is 3^z*2^s*(2^h-1)-1. Its maximum is 8 (attained at h=1,z=2 or h=2,z=1).
Therefore the separating compatible nonzero q-set has cardinality at most 8. The replay also exhaustively checks all 351 unordered distinct mask pairs and all 26 nonzero q tails.

Assume an actual canonical raw output above 3364 for one split p:q with p in {21,22,23,24,25}, q=50-p. At least K=637 distinct raw clauses are then required, so at least 609 must be genuinely new resolvents because only c=28 clauses can be retained.

Choose one non-tautological producing cross-parent pair for each of the >=609 distinct new resolvents, forming an injective representative set G. Let B=p*q-609 be the maximum number of cross pairs outside G.

For p:q=21:29,22:28,23:27,24:26,25:25 the clean-row/clean-column lower bounds (p-B,q-B) are respectively (21,29),(15,21),(11,15),(9,11),(9,9). Thus both clean cores P0,Q0 always contain at least nine distinct nonempty tails.
The >=609 distinct new signed clauses must contain both signs of every one of the six nonpivot coordinates; omitting one sign on one coordinate leaves at most 2*3^5=486 signed vectors.

P0 and Q0 cannot both use the same coordinate. A clean row and clean column containing that coordinate force one common sign throughout all parent occurrences and hence throughout G, contradicting the required opposite sign. Therefore their active-coordinate sets are disjoint.

At least nine distinct nonempty ternary tails cannot live on fewer than three coordinates because 3^2-1=8. Hence P0 and Q0 each require at least three active coordinates. With six coordinates total, their supports split exactly 3+3; call them A and B.

Every P tail has a unique projection onto A. If two distinct P tails shared an A-projection, their B-masks b1!=b2 would have to be simultaneously compatible with every q in the clean column core Q0, and injectivity of G would require union(b1,q)!=union(b2,q) for every q in Q0. The THREE_COORDINATE_TWO_MASK_SEPARATION sublemma bounds such q by 8, contradicting |Q0|>=9.
Only 2*3^2=18 of the 27 ternary A-projections contain any fixed A-coordinate. Projection injectivity therefore bounds the number of P parent tails containing that coordinate by 18.

Regularity is exact because L=n*d=350 and d=50 is the minimum live-variable degree: all seven live variables have degree exactly 50. A nonpivot coordinate occurs in at most c=28 retained clauses, so it occurs in at least 22 pivot-parent tails. Since at most 18 of the P tails contain an A-coordinate, at least four Q tails contain it.

Q0 is supported only on B, so an exceptional Q tail contains each A-coordinate. Every P0 row is clean, hence such an exceptional Q tail is compatible with every P0 tail. Its sign forbids the opposite sign throughout P0 on that coordinate.

This holds independently on all three A-coordinates. P0 is supported on A and now has only omission or one permitted sign per coordinate, giving at most 2^3-1=7 distinct nonempty tails, contradicting |P0|>=9.
Therefore an actual raw cap violation is impossible for every balanced split p:q from 21:29 through 25:25. In particular the previously open 24:26 and the remaining 25:25 transitions are cap-safe.
